_about: ASSET-003 Gorgemaw STEP 3 (2026-11-22): material recipe per part (our COPIES of vanilla materials). Colours are multipliers.

body (Lox Body).albedo: read _MainTex (256) back, paint a 512 copy: repaint.json with repaint/lox_hive_mask.png (R bark, G extremities, B veins + mouth glow, A roots + mouth) and repaint/lox_moss_mask.png (R moss)
body (Lox Body).emission: _EmissionMap = hive mask B x blight colour

Furr1 (fur cards): HIDDEN (renderer disabled); the Body's own painted fur is repainted

lump (TheHive /Visual/low), 16 parts.mesh: clone + deform/lump_offsets.json + deform/lump_uv_offsets.json; then, for the 4 DENSE lumps (mass_front_l, mass_mid_r, mass_peak, mass_hips_r), one smooth subdivision (split every edge at its midpoint, Loop-style smoothing 1.0, UVs interpolated) once at spawn

maw fangs (Troll Body claw/tooth islands.note: no root-dirt vertex colours on the Gorgemaw (the Brute's fangs have them)

eyes (eye_globe): as the Brute: kit/eye/eye_globe_core_pupil_mask.png (R core emission, G pupil)

branches (Pickable_Branch, 2 heavy limbs._MainTex: texture copy: saturation x0.35, then x(0.075, 0.058, 0.042) dark brown

biome tint (ApplyBiomeVisuals): OWNER DECISION pending, see previews/final_biome_blackforest_panel.png (left _Color only; right as coded, _EmissionColor = tint x2: the whole Gorgemaw glows flat)
